scope: 8x8 bijective cryptographic substitution boxes; literature baselines for optimization/genetic algorithms
convention: sbox[x] = S(x), x=0,...,255; 16x16 tables read left-to-right top-to-bottom; integers 0..255
caution: Verification of permutation validity does not prove source fidelity or security. Secondary tables require tracing the primary paper. All metrics should be recomputed under the same definition.
